Does the TTH option match reuse of original K16s above 550 PS?

RESEARCH RECORD [AUTHORED-004]:
TTH offers a conversion using supplied original Porsche/BorgWarner K16 cores with size-8 hot housings. It advertises up to 650 PS with appropriate engine components and recalibration. It provides no measured map, operating speed envelope or test configuration on the consulted page.

It is a documented candidate: it uses supplied K16 cores and advertises 650 PS with supporting changes. That capacity remains a supplier claim, requiring operating and engine validation. [AUTHORED-004]

Does 0.05 g demonstrate rotor qualification?

RESEARCH RECORD [AUTHORED-005]:
TTH reports a balance figure of 0.05 g. The page does not identify the associated radius, residual-unbalance unit such as g mm, speed-dependent acceptance limits or balance grade.
No. Mass alone does not define residual unbalance without a radius, and the page lacks the acceptance conditions. Obtain the actual balance report and rotor operating limits. [AUTHORED-005]

Can the TTH 750 PS listing be recorded as a K16 conversion?

RESEARCH RECORD [AUTHORED-006]:
The TTH 750 PS product is based on K24 donors with size-10 hot housings. It is a different donor route from the K16-650 product, and its advertised power depends on engine components and software changes.
No. Its documented donor is K24 with size-10 hot housings. Keep it separate from the K16 option and retain the supporting-change condition. [AUTHORED-006]
